description: Use this after launching anything long (import, search, strategy build, criteria suggestion, screening, full text, extraction, risk of bias): it waits up to about 45 seconds and returns status and done/total progress with the next steps. A finished screening job also says how many records the AI screened and how many went to human verification because of the plan quota, and human_review: the link where the researcher reviews what is left. If the job has not finished, call it again. Read-only.

kind.description: Which job family to wait for (default all).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait before answering (default and max 45). 0 = just report the current state.

name: revisia_jobs
title: Wait for a job
